notes.title: Update 3/6
notes.content:
Added a new enemy: bats
 Reworked how drop rates are calculated, so rare items are now rarer
The old method did not account for loot pool sizes, so even though (for a tier 1 chest) Common items had a 3.18% drop rate and Uncommon items had a 2.55% drop rate, an individual drop had a 30.24% chance of being any Common item, and a 35.68% chance of being any Uncommon item
The new method keeps the ratios of each rarity constant by reducing individual items' drop rates
In other words: adding an Uncommon item will now reduce the drop rates of other Uncommon items, but the odds of getting any Uncommon item will remain the same
 Upgraded to Godot 4.4
This brings several performance improvements, the most noticeable of which is the game will no longer hang for a few seconds when unlocking doors on large floors
